buyer_question: Can you review our clinic or healthtech patient workflow before we buy an AI receptionist or WhatsApp automation tool?
safe_input_to_prepare: Public website URL; redacted workflow name; source channel; current owner role; non-sensitive screenshot with identifiers removed
do_not_send: Patient names; phone numbers; Emirates IDs; MRNs; diagnoses; prescriptions; clinical notes; chat transcripts; call recordings
review_decision: Use no-credentials source map before platform configuration
proof_boundary: Synthetic buyer-education checklist only; not patient data; not compliance proof; no outreach

buyer_question: Can you review cloud or AI spend without console access?
safe_input_to_prepare: Monthly service totals; cost-category labels; budget owner; approval threshold; anomaly narrative with identifiers removed
do_not_send: Cloud console login; API tokens; invoices with customer identifiers; production logs; database exports
review_decision: Start with owner-level spend and approval map before FinOps tooling
proof_boundary: Synthetic buyer-education checklist only; not a real bill; not savings or ROI evidence

buyer_question: Can you help us answer vendor security or procurement questions?
safe_input_to_prepare: Question category; existing public policy link; accountable reviewer role; answer status; evidence owner
do_not_send: Contracts; regulator correspondence; legal advice; audit letters; unresolved incident reports; private questionnaire answers not approved for sharing
review_decision: Separate source ownership from formal adviser approval
proof_boundary: Synthetic buyer-education checklist only; not legal/privacy/security/procurement advice

buyer_question: What should be checked before Malaffi/NABIDH-style integration or patient-data hosting discussions?
safe_input_to_prepare: Integration name; data-category label; role owner; handoff dependency; redacted architecture note
do_not_send: Patient records; HIE payloads; credentials; production exports; regulator-sensitive documents
owner_to_name: IT / integration owner plus privacy adviser
review_decision: Escalate to qualified advisers before regulated-data decisions
proof_boundary: Synthetic buyer-education checklist only; not regulator approval or healthcare compliance proof

buyer_question: Can AICS help us decide whether to publish growth, compliance or AI-safety claims?
safe_input_to_prepare: Draft claim text; source link; internal owner; evidence status; approval status
do_not_send: Unsupported testimonials; logo claims; certification claims; savings; appointment-growth; no-show or patient-outcome figures without approved evidence
owner_to_name: Founder / marketing owner plus legal/privacy/security/clinical approver if needed
review_decision: Block external claim until source and approval are explicit
proof_boundary: Synthetic buyer-education checklist only; not ranking, lead, revenue, appointment-growth or AI-accuracy evidence
